title: The Emperor Who Made His Horse a Consul

scenes.text: In the year thirty-seven, Rome crowned an emperor who was only twenty-four years old, and at first absolutely everybody adored him.
scenes.prompt: stick figure roman emperor with laurel crown waving from a balcony while a crowd of tiny stick figures cheers below, painted roman city background

scenes.text: Caligula cut taxes, freed political prisoners, and threw public games that ran for entire weeks without stopping.
scenes.prompt: stick figure emperor throwing coins to a happy crowd in a roman forum, confetti and banners, painted background

scenes.text: For six straight months he was the most beloved man in the empire. Then he fell gravely ill.
scenes.prompt: stick figure emperor lying pale in a bed surrounded by worried stick figure doctors, dark candlelit roman bedroom

scenes.text: When he recovered, everyone who knew him swore that he had come back as a completely different person.
scenes.prompt: stick figure emperor pointing angrily at the sea while confused stick figure soldiers stab the waves with spears, painted beach

scenes.text: He demanded to be worshipped as a god, replaced the heads on statues with his own, and declared war on the sea itself.
scenes.prompt: stick figure soldiers marching in formation carrying seashells on cushions, roman road with painted hills behind

scenes.text: His troops obeyed. They collected seashells from the beach as spoils of war and paraded them all the way back to Rome.
scenes.prompt: a horse standing inside a luxurious marble stable with ivory furniture and a golden feeding bowl, stick figure servants bowing

scenes.text: But his most famous idea was Incitatus, his favourite horse, who lived in a marble stable with ivory furniture and his own servants. The chronicles say the animal was on his way to becoming a consul of Rome. He never made it. Caligula was murdered by his own guard after four years. The horse outlived him.
scenes.prompt: a horse sitting at a long banquet table surrounded by stick figure senators raising cups, painted roman dining hall
